description: Check whether a TCP port answers, such as db.internal:5432 or https://example.com

target.description: host:port, [IPv6]:port, or a URL whose scheme gives the port

timeout.description: Seconds to wait, from 1 to 120; 5 by default <seconds>

name: net.check

address.description: The address that answered; null when none did.

code.description: The operating system's error code, such as ECONNREFUSED.

output.description: What a program the command ran printed

truncated.description: Where the result was cut to fit, and how much
